setup: 1. Import this JSON into n8n (Workflows → Import from file)
2. Make sure SHOPIFY_ADMIN_TOKEN is set in n8n environment variables (Settings → Environment Variables)
4. Copy the workflow ID from the URL
5. In the main YFB Chat workflow, add a 'Call n8n Workflow' tool node connected to AI Agent → Tool
6. Set workflowId to the ID from step 4
7. Name: search_books | Description: Search the Yellow Feather Books catalogue by book title or author name. Returns title, price, and stock availability.
